name: cpig-72-map-helical
description: 72 Map Field Helical (R6.5 Phase E Batch 1 — Mapping)

setup.vlmDescription: A light-blue bulbous organic volume, roughly shell-shaped, filling the viewport. Identity verified by pixel-diff baseline, not VLM — confusable with Map Toroidal.
setup.whatItDoes: Wraps a source field into a helical band around an axis. u runs around the axis (de-twisted by twist_rate), v runs along the axis, w is the radial offset.
setup.whatYouShouldSee: A light-blue bulbous shell-like volume. NOTE: the render shows a closed organic volume, not a clearly twisted/helical strip. Identity verified by pixel-diff baseline, not VLM.

requires.fix: install the Slop yak package; on a dev machine a Release net48 build ships it to the Drive folder GH loads from - check `canary doctor` output for the location actually in use
install the CPig yak package, or on a dev machine build %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% CPig.Grasshopper (net48) and register its output folder in Grasshopper Developer Settings
this test loads a Slop definition from the CANARY_REPO_CPIG repo; check that repo out and point %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% at it (see workloads/tokens.json)
